work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. XLII at 38186, synopsis/summary through 38241 and the actual Ioannes protocol at 38243–38244 introduce one continuous act of forty clauses. The oath forms at 38390–38450 and 38646–38686 are expressly prescribed within clauses 8 and 18 and remain integral, not independent instruments. The rules, taxes and final publication/registration requirements continue through 39035, followed by the conventional sanction at 39037–39040 before XLIII at 39043. The abbreviated sanction at 39040 remains literal and is not expanded. The printed running-header numbering XXI (dictus XXII) is not silently harmonized with modern attribution. No historical note or ambiguous source membership was found. There is no surviving dating clause in this witness; null date and the frozen empty date_raw are retained and do not themselves bar admission.
